name: Dandelion (Cultivated)

schedule.notes: Pick outer leaves at 4 to 6 in. Blanch with a clay pot 2 weeks before harvest to sweeten.

harvest.cues: Leaves 4 to 8 in, bright green, before flower stalk emerges. Pre-flower roots are best for roasting (dandelion coffee).
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge in damp paper 3 to 5 days. Roots: dig, dry, roast at 350 F until brittle, grind for caffeine-free coffee substitute.

varieties.name: Italiko Rosso
varieties.notes: Red-veined dandelion-style chicory. Less bitter than wild dandelion.

varieties.name: Améliore
varieties.notes: Cultivated French dandelion. Broader leaves, milder than wild.

notes: Cultivated types are milder than lawn weeds. Italian and French traditions treat the leaves as a spring delicacy. Roots make a legitimate coffee substitute. WARNING: pollen and dander allergens; some people react.
